description: Unit tests verifying the filtering of 'search_tool_name' parameter in the LiteLLM project, focusing on ensuring it is not passed to external search provider APIs and that it is present in all_litellm_params. The file imports utility functions and tests their behavior with sample data.

methods.name: test_search_tool_name_in_all_litellm_params()
methods.description: Checks that 'search_tool_name' is included in the all_litellm_params list to prevent it from being sent externally.

methods.name: test_filter_out_search_tool_name()
methods.description: Verifies that filter_out_litellm_params correctly removes 'search_tool_name', 'metadata', and 'litellm_call_id' from the parameters and retains others.
